settings.content: Controls the Track your build page. Only IDs listed here can see a tracking view. One rider per line:  XR-4F2K-9L07 : 2 : Austin, TX : 30.27 : -97.74 : 2026-08-10  — that is  ID : stage : city : latitude : longitude : date the current stage started.  Stages: 1 Order confirmed, 2 Preparing your order, 3 Key out for delivery, 4 Final shakedown, 5 Bike out for delivery, 6 Delivered. The date is what fills the progress bar on the active stage, so update it whenever you move someone forward.
